definitions.explanation: The liquid waste passed from the body. The clinical, neutral word, used by doctors, in health checks and on medical forms.

examples.japanese: {尿|にょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Dark urine is a sign of not drinking enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧いちばん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尿|にょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: On the day of the health check, you collect your first urine of the morning in a container and take it along.

notes:
Register matters for this word. {尿|にょう} is clinical; ⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧ is plain and a little coarse; ⟦おしっこ→おしっこ：09083_oshikko⟧ is the soft everyday word, especially with children.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{尿検査|にょうけんさ}→尿検査：23300_nyoukensa⟧: urine test
- {尿意|にょうい}: the urge to urinate
- {頻尿|ひんにょう}: frequent urination
- ⟦{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}→糖尿病：04414_tounyoubyou⟧: diabetes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おしっこ→おしっこ：09083_oshikko⟧: pee; childish or casual
- ⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧: urine, urination; plain, somewhat crude
